sets.relationshipLabel: the place and the items kept there
sets.explanation: Each first word is a container built to hold the second: a sharps container holds spent needles, an autoclave holds instruments waiting to be sterilized.

sets.relationshipLabel: the thing applied to stop a change from taking hold
sets.explanation: Antiseptic is applied to keep infection from setting in, just as sunscreen is applied to keep a tattoo from fading — both are preventive measures against a specific harm.

sets.relationshipLabel: the stage that marks a boundary of the larger process
sets.explanation: Consultation opens the tattoo process the way sitting begins the work itself, and touch-up closes it out much as healing finishes the body's part — each word names a boundary stage of the same span.

sets.relationshipLabel: the original and its made image
sets.explanation: A sketch is transferred into a stencil to guide the needle, and a finished piece is captured in a Polaroid afterward — in both cases the first thing is rendered into a second, separate image of itself.
